name: langguard-arbiter
description: LangGuard checks MCP tool calls against your organization's policies.

host.title: Address
host.description: Your organization's own LangGuard address, like https://yourcompany.app.langguard.ai.

api_token.title: API key
api_token.description: Create an Arbiter key in LangGuard: Settings, Arbiter Management, Deployment.

enforcement_mode.title: Mode
enforcement_mode.description: cooperative: when LangGuard cannot check a call, it asks you first. strict: when LangGuard cannot check a call, it blocks the call.

bundle_key.title: Policy signing key
bundle_key.description: The public key that signs your organization's policy bundle, in PEM form. Your administrator sets it. Leave it empty to take the key from LangGuard.

opa_path.title: OPA program
opa_path.description: The full path of an OPA 1.20.2 program that your administrator installed. Leave it empty to let the mod fetch the pinned program.
